summary: Tested DELETE /api/admin/locations/{id}, Tiffin.js + Catering.js DB refactor, and ran regression over /api/promotions, /api/centers, /api/center-timeslots, /api/tiffin-config, /api/tiffin-items, /api/catering-packages, /api/locations, /api/menu. Backend: 14/15 pytest cases PASS — 401/403 without auth, 401/403 with bad token, 404 on nonexistent id, 200 on successful delete, 404 on double-delete, baseline 8 centers intact, catering packages return 4 India + 4 Australia with correct ₹450/600/750/950 and $35/45/55/70 prices, all regression endpoints 200 with expected shape. 1 FAILURE: cascade delete of center_timeslots does NOT work — the DELETE handler at /app/backend/server.py L604-611 queries center_timeslots by location_id (UUID) but documents are keyed by center_id (e.g. 'pb-hsr'), so custom timeslots are ORPHANED on location delete. Cleaned one orphan row during test teardown. Frontend: Tiffin page renders correctly for India+any-of-7 centers (₹299 fallback, 'Saturday & Sunday' days, Unlimited Breakfast section, 8–11 AM timings) and Australia+Perth ($35 per person subtitle confirmed via inner_text inspection). Catering page renders all 4 India packages with ₹450/600/750/950 pricing and 'Most Popular' badge. Admin 'delete-location-{center_id}' button exists in source (Admin.js L2224-2225) but couldn't be exercised end-to-end — the /admin Locations tab is reachable only via [role=tab] (no data-testid) and the global 'Welcome to Purnabramha' modal/ main-nav intercepts clicks (carry-over from iteration_13); API-level delete is fully covered.

critical.issue: Cascade delete of center_timeslots is BROKEN. server.py line 610 does `db.center_timeslots.delete_one({"center_id": location_id})` — but location_id is the location document's UUID, while center_timeslots are keyed by the human center_id (e.g. 'pb-hsr'). Result: when an admin deletes a location, its saved time-slots become orphaned in center_timeslots. Fix: fetch the location doc BEFORE delete_one to capture center_id, then cascade with {"center_id": <captured>}.

issues: TabsTrigger value='locations' has no data-testid (Admin.js L1368). Other admin tabs have testids like tiffin-admin-tab, catering-admin-tab, promotions-admin-tab. Recommend adding data-testid='locations-admin-tab' for automation parity.
'Welcome to Purnabramha' auth/intent modal still overlays /admin on first render (carry-over from iteration_13) — requires JS bypass in Playwright tests.

action_items: FIX cascade delete bug: in DELETE /api/admin/locations/{location_id}, fetch the location first, read its center_id, then cascade delete center_timeslots by that center_id (and optionally center_hours / any other center-keyed collections). Current code silently fails the cascade.
Add data-testid='locations-admin-tab' to the Locations TabsTrigger in Admin.js L1368 for test parity.
Dismiss / suppress the 'Welcome to Purnabramha' modal on /admin so real users (and tests) don't have to manually close it.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L601-611 DELETE handler: the 'Best-effort cascade' comment acknowledges uncertainty — but the implementation is wrong (location_id vs center_id). Write a follow-up GET-before-DELETE or use $or match on both ids.
No audit/log entry is emitted on location hard-delete — consider at minimum a structured log line with actor email + center_id for traceability given this is destructive.

Admin.js handleDeleteLocation uses window.confirm — fine for MVP but inconsistent with shadcn Dialog patterns used elsewhere in the admin panel (e.g. hero image delete). Consider migrating to AlertDialog for consistency.
Tiffin.js correctly falls back to tiffin-config.json when /api/tiffin-config returns [] (DB empty). Pricing swap on Australia selection verified ($35 subtitle). No regression.
Catering.js correctly dedupes packages by id and filters by region via price_per_person_inr>0 / price_per_person_aud>0. All 4 tiers per region render. No regression.
catering_packages API returns 8 packages + 56 menu items as claimed by main agent; response shape {packages:{india, australia}, menuOptions:{...}} matches Catering.js expectations.

success_rate.backend: 93.3% (14/15) — 1 failing test pinpoints the cascade-delete bug
success_rate.frontend: Tiffin + Catering flows verified visually and via DOM text extraction; Admin Locations delete button exists in source but end-to-end click not exercised due to tab/modal overlay

seed_data_creation: Test created (and cleaned up) 2 TEST locations with center_id prefix 'pb-test-del-' and 'pb-test-dd-'. One orphan center_timeslots row left behind by the cascade bug was manually deleted via motor script. Final DB state: 8 baseline locations only, no TEST_ remnants.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the cascade bug, re-run: `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_locations_delete_and_pages.py -v`. The only expected failing test currently is TestLocationDelete::test_create_then_delete_with_cascade — it asserts that custom timeslots saved for a deleted location's center_id no longer appear in GET /api/center-timeslots/{center_id}. The fix must read the location's center_id BEFORE delete_one, then cascade. Also recommend adding data-testid='locations-admin-tab' to Admin.js L1368 so a Playwright test can reliably reach the Locations tab and exercise the delete-location-{center_id} button end-to-end (the button itself is already correctly implemented with window.confirm). The 'Welcome to Purnabramha' modal overlay on /admin is still a carry-over nuisance for automation.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: /app/backend/server.py line 610 — `await db.center_timeslots.delete_one({"center_id": location_id})` passes the location document's UUID (location_id) as the center_id filter. But center_timeslots documents use the human-readable center_id (e.g. 'pb-hsr', 'pb-test-del-1762999999'), so the filter never matches and the orphan row stays. REPRO: 1) POST /api/admin/locations with center_id='pb-test-x'; 2) PUT /api/admin/center-timeslots/pb-test-x with custom slots; 3) DELETE /api/admin/locations/{returned_id}; 4) GET /api/center-timeslots/pb-test-x — custom slots still present. FIX: `loc = await db.locations.find_one({"id": location_id}, {"_id": 0}); if not loc: raise HTTPException(404); cid = loc.get('center_id'); await db.locations.delete_one({'id': location_id}); if cid: await db.center_timeslots.delete_one({'center_id': cid})`.
